ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower part of Figure 8 shows a nearly horizontal river. Along the river, A, B, and C are labeled from left to right, and there is also P to the right of C. Above A, B, and C, three river cross-section diagrams are connected respectively: the section at A is labeled "coniferous forest," the section at B is labeled "broadleaf forest," and the section at C is labeled "paddy field." The legend indicates primary forest/coniferous forest, secondary forest/broadleaf forest, paddy field/mulberry-fruit forest, and uses "new → old" to indicate a geomorphic or depositional age sequence. In the three cross sections, it can be seen that the river channel is not completely symmetrical, and there is a phenomenon in which one side of the channel is deeper and the bank slope is steeper. Reasoning: According to the geomorphic-vegetation sequence in the figure in which A is coniferous forest, B is broadleaf forest, and C is paddy field/mulberry-fruit forest, it can be judged that reach A is more upstream and reach C is more downstream, so the overall flow direction of the river is from A to C. Facing downstream, that is, when observing along the direction from A to C, the side in the cross section where the channel is deeper and the bank slope is steeper corresponds to the right bank, indicating that the right bank of this natural river is more strongly eroded. According to the geostrophic deflection law, horizontally moving objects in the Northern Hemisphere deflect to the right, and the right bank of a river is more obviously eroded; in the Southern Hemisphere they deflect to the left bank. Therefore this river is located in the Northern Hemisphere.

raw_record.question_text:
The river in Figure 8 was formed under natural conditions. A, B, and C are three points on different river reaches of this river, and their cross sections are shown in the following figure. Read the figure and answer: In which hemisphere is this river located?

<image1>

method.method_draft: 描述图像后，先根据A针叶林、B阔叶林、C稻田/桑果林的地貌—植被序列，判断A为较上游、C为较下游，河流总体从A向C流。然后检查横剖面中河槽偏深、岸坡较陡的一侧，确定该侧是面向下游时的右岸。最后套用地转偏向规律：自然河流右岸受冲刷更强对应北半球，因此答案为北半球。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图8下方画出一条近水平的河流，河流沿线从左到右标有A、B、C，C右侧还有P。A、B、C上方分别连接三个河流横剖面图：A处剖面上标注“针叶林”，B处剖面上标注“阔叶林”，C处剖面上标注“稻田”。图例说明有原生林/针叶林、次生林/阔叶林、稻田/桑果林，并用“新→老”表示地貌或沉积年龄序列。三个横剖面中可见河槽并非完全对称，存在一侧河槽较深、岸坡较陡的现象。
推理：按图中A为针叶林、B为阔叶林、C为稻田/桑果林的地貌—植被序列，可判断A河段较上游，C河段较下游，所以河流总体流向为从A到C。面向下游，即沿A到C方向观察时，横剖面中河槽偏深、岸坡较陡的一侧对应右岸，说明该自然河流右岸受冲刷更强。根据地转偏向规律，北半球水平运动物体向右偏，河流右岸受冲刷更明显；南半球则偏向左岸。因此该河流位于北半球。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 自然状态河流受地转偏向力影响：北半球流水向右偏，右岸流速较大、冲刷较强，常表现为右岸较陡、河槽偏深；南半球相反。若图示冲刷岸在下游方向的右岸，则为北半球。

method.method_draft: 描述图像后，不直接从岸坡陡缓下结论，而是使用图例的“新→老”沉积年龄信息。先据A—B—C的植被和土地利用序列判定下游方向为A到C；再从剖面纹理读出较新的河流堆积主要在面向下游的左岸一侧，而河道迁移和冲刷指向右岸。由于自然河流若持续右岸侵蚀、左岸堆积，说明流水受向右偏转的地转偏向力作用，所以该河流位于北半球。
method.CoT_raw:

推理：先依据A、B、C的植被和土地利用变化，针叶林到阔叶林再到稻田，反映从较上游自然植被区逐渐过渡到较下游平原农业区，因此河流下游方向应为A到C。再按图例的“新→老”沉积年龄信息读剖面，较新的河流堆积主要出现在面向下游时的左岸一侧，而相对冲刷、河道迁移指向右岸。自然条件下河流若长期表现为右岸侵蚀、左岸堆积，说明流水运动受到向右偏转的地转偏向力影响。地转偏向力使运动物体向右偏转发生在北半球，因此该河流位于北半球。

图8中的河流是在自然条件下形成的，A、B、C为该河流不同河段上的三个点，其横剖面如下图所示。读图回答：该河流位于哪个半球？

raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The lower part of Figure 8 shows a nearly horizontal river. Along the river, A, B, and C are labeled from left to right, and there is also P to the right of C. Above A, B, and C, three river cross-section diagrams are connected respectively: the section at A is labeled "coniferous forest," the section at B is labeled "broadleaf forest," and the section at C is labeled "paddy field." The legend indicates primary forest/coniferous forest, secondary forest/broadleaf forest, paddy field/mulberry-fruit forest, and uses "new → old" to indicate a geomorphic or depositional age sequence.
